sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Faithfully encodes the ship-owned inputs, Table 6-6 and Table 6-7 lookup cases with controlled references and evidence, explicit propeller-location pairing, unitless decimal quantity constraints, and the N_ice formula with expected-result-scaled tolerance.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the Table 6-7 selection semantics: propellerLocation is currently required on the ship but is never connected to, or used to validate, the Table 6-7 lookup case, so any evidenced factor can pass regardless of the ship's location. Locate and use the canonical table-case location selection/value term (or canonical relationship) to place the selected location and selectedPropellerLocationFactor on the same Table 6-7 case, require the case location to equal the ship's propellerLocation, and retain the evidence and k1 equality checks.

Require exactly one Table 6-6 lookup case and exactly one Table 6-7 lookup case for each ship (add qualifiedMaxCount 1 alongside each qualifiedMinCount 1). The current graph permits multiple same-table cases, allowing contradictory or unrelated selections while a single matching case makes the equality checks pass.

Faithfully encodes the ship-owned inputs, Table 6-6 and Table 6-7 lookup cases with controlled references and evidence, explicit propeller-location pairing, unitless decimal quantity constraints, and the N_ice formula with expected-result-scaled tolerance.
